query: INSERT INTO assistant_conversation_sources(workspace_id,conversation_id,session_id,login_id,provider_conversation_id,agent_id,text_only,ordinal) SELECT $1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,coalesce(max(ordinal),0)+1 FROM assistant_conversation_sources WHERE workspace_id=$1 AND conversation_id=$2 RETURNING jsonb_build_object('id',id,'conversation_id',conversation_id,'session_id',session_id,'ordinal',ordinal,'revision',revision,'state',state) AS "data!"
